comment:engines: 22.x, raised from >=20.11 — and that old floor was the bug behind a production 500. firebase-admin@14 -> jwks-rsa@4.1.0 is CommonJS and does `require('jose')` on line 1 of src/utils.js, while jose@6 dropped CommonJS entirely: its exports map has no `require` condition, only an ESM `default`. That combination only loads on a runtime that can require() an ES module — Node >=20.19 or >=22.12, which is exactly what jwks-rsa declares in its OWN engines field. Local Node 22.14 has it enabled by default, so every build and test passed here; Vercel's serverless runtime was older and every request died with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. Pinned to the 22 line rather than the full `^20.19 || ^22.12 || >=23` range, because that is the form Vercel reads when selecting a runtime and it is the line this project is actually tested on. Declared in BOTH apps as well as here: with Vercel's Root Directory set to apps/portal, that is the package.json it reads.
